reason: The hypothesis combines the active-learning DNN training approach from high-entropy carbonitrides (P2) with the actively-learned MTP framework for refractory MPEAs (P6, P7) and applies it to the specific problem of thermodynamic integration for solid-liquid free energies, which none of the passages address. The predicted 30–40% reduction and the specific falsification test are new, but the core idea of using an actively-learned ML potential to replace EAM is a direct combination of existing proposals and results.
